projects.title: Attendance Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: A complete face-recognition attendance workflow with admin controls, reporting, and configurable recognition behavior.
projects.challenge: Move beyond a single-camera demo and create a usable attendance workflow with safer recognition decisions.
projects.solution: Combined vector descriptors, unknown-person rejection, liveness checks, multi-face scanning, admin management, and SQLite history.
projects.outcome: A portfolio-grade local platform with analytics, corrections, exports, user-photo management, and automatic retraining.

projects.title: Emotion-Aware Music Recommender
projects.summary: A webcam-powered experience that reads emotion signals and turns them into an explorable playlist.
projects.challenge: Make a facial-emotion prototype useful even when a heavy local ML stack or webcam is unavailable.
projects.solution: Added ranked emotion capture, mood normalization, scored recommendations, demo presets, insights, and CSV export.
projects.outcome: A polished Streamlit flow that supports both live inference and a dependable demonstration mode.

projects.title: Team10 Sprint Board
projects.summary: A lightweight sprint workspace for planning, ownership, status tracking, and backlog visibility.
projects.challenge: Give a small team a useful project command center without introducing a complex hosted stack.
projects.solution: Built task creation, ownership, sprint labels, filters, status changes, metrics, local JSON persistence, and CSV export.
projects.outcome: A simple but real team workflow with modular services and a verification path for sprint analytics.

projects.title: Python Utility Toolkit
projects.summary: A dependency-light command-line toolkit for everyday text, JSON, file, and checksum workflows.
projects.challenge: Turn a placeholder repository into a small tool that demonstrates useful, reusable Python structure.
projects.solution: Created modular text, JSON, file-stat, slug, formatting, and SHA-256 commands with tests and clear usage examples.
projects.outcome: A compact CLI foundation that is easy to run, understand, extend, and reuse for scripting experiments.
